answer: Farming becomes a ripple bet on surviving 62 epochs of grading, and every lantern settlement recomputes the grove schedule, so a hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 6 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 62 epochs rather than arriving at once. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
